usageNotes: Returns the list of available sub-resources under the /access/openid path (e.g., 'login', 'callback', 'auth-url'). Use this as a discovery call to confirm which OpenID Connect endpoints are exposed by the cluster before calling them. No authentication is required beyond a valid API token, and no parameters are needed.
tips: The returned 'subdir' values are the relative child paths — append them to /access/openid/ to construct the full endpoint URLs.
This is a directory index only; it does not initiate or validate any OpenID Connect flow.
